title: suck_pull: cursor updated even when 0 articles fetched — NEWNEWS window silently shrinks
description: suck_pull.rs line 219: update_cursor(pool, group, now_unix).await? runs unconditionally at end of each group loop, even when NEWNEWS returned an error code (summary.failed += 1; continue) that left msgids empty. If NEWNEWS fails for a group, the cursor is still advanced to now_unix, meaning the next pull will not re-try articles from the window that failed. Articles in the [old_cursor, now_unix] window are silently skipped forever. Should only update cursor when NEWNEWS succeeds (code 230) and processing completes without total failure.
